sources.primary_title: From HACCP to Halal: Smobler Takes Vertical AI Food Compliance Push to LEAP 2026
sources.verified_angle_summary: Singapore-based tech company Smobler is using LEAP 2026 to explore expanding its Robin AI platform into the MENA and ASEAN regions, focusing on Halal compliance workflows. Originally launched in Hawaii in June 2026 to help food entrepreneurs with U.S. FDA and HACCP compliance, Robin AI automates the drafting of nutrition labels and food-safety plans. Co-Founder and CTO Mridhul Pax is attending LEAP to meet potential partners across food technology, enterprise AI, and digital trade to adapt the system for Halal certification authorities and auditors. The move aligns with Smobler's strategy of developing vertical AI applications for specific industry workflows, such as food trade and maritime logistics, rather than general-purpose AI.
sources.verified_key_facts: Smobler is exploring expanding Robin AI to handle Halal compliance workflows across ASEAN and MENA; Robin AI was initially launched in Hawaii in June 2026 to assist with FDA and HACCP compliance; The platform helps early-stage food entrepreneurs generate draft nutrition labels and food-safety plans; Smobler CTO Mridhul Pax is attending LEAP 2026 to meet partners in food tech and digital trade; The expansion aims to support recognized Halal certification authorities and auditors; Smobler is also developing Forage AI for B2B food trade and exploring blockchain maritime infrastructure
